The space
This is a lovely 3 bedroom  tri level home beautifully  decorated and located just 5mins from the Nashville airport, and 15mins,from down town.. 5mins from The Percy Priest Lake, 5 mins from Opryland..5 mins from grocery stores, and casual dining. in a quite neighborhood on a culdesac..just suitable for an intimate getaway with towering  trees, and a relaxing back patio just suitable for gatherings, with a glass of wine..

Guest access
You have the full top floor to include kitchen, dining room, living room , patio, bathroom and of course your 3 bedrooms, that sleeps 6.  with your own private entrance..with a key code lock.There are security camera's facing the front and back doors of the home which will be recording at all times  for security reasons only.. Dedicated wifi.. cable .. and a variety of board games..

Other things to note
Upon conformation of your stay, you would be required to provide a cell# or email address, where you would be given  the front door code to gain access to the house, and also information about  house rules, this is a non smoking home, but for smokers.. the private back  patio would be appropriate. I also offer self ck in to guest travelling on business.There is a $25 cxl fee
